description: Issue an invoice for a client from billable time between two dates. Totals are computed on the server from the logged entries (one line per project). The number defaults to the next INV-<year>-NNN. This creates a permanent record; confirm the client, period and dates with the user first.

client.description: Client id or exact client name

compact_notes.description: Shorten entry descriptions to about 100 characters

due_date.description: Payment due date, YYYY-MM-DD, or null for none

from.description: First day of the billed period

include_detail.description: Print each entry under the lines

notes.description: Notes printed on the invoice (max 1,000 characters)

number.description: Invoice number; defaults to the next INV-<year>-NNN

to.description: Last day of the billed period

name: create_invoice
title: Create an invoice
